voci.titolo: What’s Happening in EM: Bond Investors Turn to Developing World
voci.riassunto: This week, Mpho Hlakudi and Selcuk Gokoluk discuss how some of the world’s biggest asset managers increase their exposure to emerging markets despite the surge in US Treasury yields, weakening a traditional correlation in financial markets.
